environment.description: EKS pod running identical gRPC transfer service with pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode. PostgreSQL 14 configured with default_transaction_isolation set to 'serializable' via RDS parameter group (banking-pg14-serializable-params). pgBouncer server_reset_query includes 'RESET ALL' ensuring session parameters propagate. RDS instance class db.r6g.xlarge with enhanced monitoring. Pod resource limits set to 512Mi memory, 500m CPU. Istio sidecar with per-connection rate limiting at 50 req/s per source IP via EnvoyFilter CRD (banking-ratelimit-filter). Note: pgBouncer prepared_statements_mode=server with max_prepared_statements=0 to avoid stale plan caching under serializable.
